title: Editor freeze after waking PC from sleep
body:
### Tested versions

4.7 stable

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 10 (build 19044) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 980 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8253) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-2600K CPU @ 3.40GHz (8 threads) - 15.96 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

I often leave Godot open in the background (possibly minimized) when I put my PC to sleep for the night. The next day when I wake it up I am able to use my PC without issue for as long as I want. But as soon as I activate/restore the Godot window for the first time after waking from sleep, within seconds my entire PC becomes unresponsive for about 1-2 minutes.

When I say unresponsive I mean the mouse and display freeze almost immediately. If I'm playing music or have a video going, the audio will keep playing for a little while but eventually stop, presumably when the buffer runs out. I can still hear "things happening" like my hard drive grinding, presumably restoring cached data from the hard drive to RAM.

I checked logs and I don't see anything out of the ordinary. I also ran the Console editor and it doesn't output anything to the console before or after the lockup. If there's something else I can do, or somewhere else to look for information that may help see what's going on, please let me know.

I also did an experiment to see if the length of sleep affected the issue, so I put my PC to sleep and woke it up again after a few seconds, then activated Godot. It immediately locked up for about 1.5 minutes.

### Steps to reproduce

Have a Godot project open. Minimize it. Put PC to sleep. Wake PC up. Activate Godot window. Experience freeze. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A - not project dependent
